prior_evidence_unchanged: #4752 scoped pooled PASS and A/B breakdown
hypothesis: For a fresh #4752-style synthetic task with a diversified-position training arm, position-random evaluation on the same frozen fitted weights yields at least 0.20 greater positive ACCEPT than an equal-budget position-block extrapolation cohort.

H_T_D_C_U.H: The pooled diversified-arm positive-ACCEPT rate in position_random minus spatial_block is >=0.20 across five paired seeds, using identical frozen model weights within each paired cohort comparison.
H_T_D_C_U.T: Train a center-only control and five-center diversified MLP per each of five preregistered seeds. Evaluate base, position_random and spatial_block with independent renderer/noise streams, 512 positives plus 512 fixed-distractor negatives per seed/cohort, 64 unique evaluation centers per non-base cohort (16 per quadrant), eight noise/source rows per center. Candidate once; independent raw-only auditor/refitter once; retries zero.

D.H_PASS_SCOPED: Auditor reconstructs all data/weights/predictions; both arms have base positive ACCEPT >=0.80; all negative false-ACCEPT rates across all cohorts/arms <=0.05; every spatial block has >=8 unique centers and >=100 positive rows; diversified pooled position_random minus spatial_block positive-ACCEPT gap >=0.20.
D.H_FAIL_SCOPED: All audit, competence, false-ACCEPT and support gates pass, but the diversified pooled gap is <0.20.
D.HOLD_MODEL_INCOMPETENT_OR_FALSE_ACCEPT: Either arm misses base competence or any negative false-ACCEPT limit.
D.HOLD_AUDIT_INTEGRITY: Any raw, row, source, weight, independent-refit, prediction or denominator reconstruction fails.
D.STOP: Any prelaunch source/main/image/output/resource/runtime failure; candidate or auditor nonzero; no retry.

H_T_D_C_U.C: Position_random (nearest support distance 9 <= d < 27) and spatial_block (d >=27) are distinct, prospectively declared interpolation/extrapolation envelopes; their unadjusted difference is not estimator bias. A 144x144 tile and fan-in-scaled initializer are versioned changes from #4752. The 9x9 renderer, class balance, target/distractor amplitude and decision thresholds are retained.
H_T_D_C_U.U: No evidence for real GUI layouts, production spatial autocorrelation, human/agent performance, calibration transfer, authority, safety, or product benefit. Five seeds and one synthetic renderer do not establish generality.
